## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Failed saves should report failure instead of announcing success. This review found one important defect in the save command.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Saving to a destination whose parent directory is absent discards `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns `0` without creating the report. The broad `OSError` handler also hides permission and disk-write failures; the unavailable-destination test asserts no failure signal. Propagate the exception or return a nonzero status with an actionable error, announce success only after a successful write, and assert that behavior in the failure test. — Users and callers receive a success indication when their report was not saved.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Cleanup explicitly tolerates absent temporary reports while preserving other errors; the tests exercise both behaviors.
